the bank codes of FINDINGS-prom_ab-sound-selection. Hands (bank, group, member) to T_F41EEC (prom_b sub_F5B81C, two 0x2030-list records). ScreenEnter_SoundEditMemoryWrite passes the write's destination Var27E9. Basis: caller + body + bank codes.
evidence: prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:155059 `call sub_FD68AD` -- ScreenEnter_SoundEditMemoryWrite, after the write completes, with Var27E9 (155055)
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:155013 `call ToneMsg80_Id01` -- Var27E9 is the number the write request (ToneMsg80_Id01, 0x9E) was sent with
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:142655 `calr Var27F5_Get` -- drum vs sound
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:142662 `ld h, 0x28:opc` -- UD bank for n < 2, 0x29 (142666) with n - 2
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:142676 `ld h, 0x09:opc` -- n >= 0x80 -> U2, else 0x08 (142679)
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:142686 `srl d, 0x03` -- group = (n mod 0x80) >> 3, member = & 7 (142688)
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:142699 `call T_F41EEC` -- (bank, group, member) pushed
notes/FINDINGS-prom_ab-sound-selection.md:14 `- U1 / U2 0x08 / 0x09, E1 0x10;` -- bank codes; UD 0x28 / 0x29 on line 16
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:131400 `sub_F5B81C:` -- T_F41EEC target: T_List2030_AppendRegs twice

(page, down) Steps the LFO number kept per page -- AMPLITUDE (0) (0x27CF), PITCH (1) (0x27D0), FILTER (2) (0x27D1) -- down when the second argument is non-zero, else up, wrapping 1..4; other pages untouched.
The cells SoundEditLfo_GetSelectedLfo reads. Called by SoundEditLfo_SoftKeyCol2 before it posts the page's repaint request. Basis: caller + body + reader.
